Select compound ChEMBL identifier, canonical SMILES, compound key, PubMed ID or DOI, assay description, standard type, standard relation, standard value, standard units, activity comment, target ChEMBL identifier, target name, and target organism. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, join assays on assay_id, join target_dictionary on tid, join compound_records on record_id, join docs on doc_id, and join compound_structures on molregno. Filter by target ChEMBL ID CHEMBL4282 and standard_type IC50. Keep all activity rows without deduplication. Sort by compound ChEMBL identifier, canonical SMILES, compound key, PubMed ID or DOI, assay description, standard type, standard relation, standard value, standard units, activity comment, target ChEMBL identifier, target name, and target organism.
